name: m4a1
stats_provenance: CS:S M4A1 model and sounds, with its 30-round magazine and 600 rpm firing rate. Damage 1.45x and spread 1.0x are our balance relative to Halo's assault rifle; the 3.1 s reload is timed for this game's animation. The silencer toggle is not implemented.
view_model_mirrored_provenance: CS:S view models are authored left-handed; the game mirrors them with cl_righthand 1.
